note: Lab and kind notes confirmed. The post's body does not state the date in a sentence; the date is the post's listing and page date on anthropic.com (also listed at https://www.anthropic.com/news as 'Introducing Claude Sonnet 5.5', Sep 28, 2026). Corroborated by https://letsdatascience.com/news/anthropic-releases-claude-sonnet-55-with-faster-responses-an-95c4c0b5, which states: "Anthropic announced Claude Sonnet 5.5 on September 28, 2026." The Anthropic body sentence on availability reads: "Claude Sonnet 5.5 is now available on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure." No separate preview or waitlist was found, so the Sep 28 date is general availability. The Kiro changelog (https://kiro.dev/changelog/models/claude-sonnet-5-5/, dated Oct 2, 2026) is a third-party integration date and was not used as the release date.
queries: Anthropic announces Claude Sonnet 5.5 generally available
